skeptic.objection: Beyond the Rural Residential plan category the first pass found, the same adopted 2025 plan works against trucks at this exact corner: its 2026-2030 work program item T.47 (Gullatt Road, 2027-2028) is a mini-roundabout at Johnson Road with No Through Truck Traffic signage, and its policy text says the Gullatt Road calming is meant to discourage truck intrusion. Johnson and Gullatt are the parcel's two frontage roads, the plan's industrial policy asks for direct truck-route access, and the parcel adjoins homesteaded houses and a planned city park. The parcel also appears to drain to the Line Creek small water supply watershed (the county sewer pipes beside it are in the Line Creek basin), where the state Part 5 criteria carry a 25% impervious limit and stream buffers that Fairburn's code follows. Together these make an industrial rezoning against the plan unlikely and the building fit optimistic, but no document shows the land is unavailable, so a person must settle it with Fairburn planning.
